Method of Attack: Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) portal allowing anyone to generate ransomware executable by filling a form
Ransom note with link to payment site and decrypter
Ransomware demands ransom payment in Bitcoin
Potential scam to keep ransom payments without paying distributors
Attack Vector: RaaS portal on the Dark Web requiring Bitcoin address and CAPTCHA
Users generate ransomware payloads and distribute to victims
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note text: 'Your files have been encrypted. To decrypt your files, follow instructions here.'
